credentials.instructions: UnifyEM needs your administrator username and password. MCPFusion logs in to UnifyEM as you and keeps the session token; UnifyEM sees the requests as your account. Enter the same credentials you use with uem-cli (UEM_USER / UEM_PASS).

endpoints.name: Ping Server
endpoints.description: Check that the UnifyEM server is reachable and that your credentials are valid.

endpoints.name: List Agents
endpoints.description: List every registered agent with metadata: agent_id, friendly_name, active, first_seen, last_seen, last_ip, version, build, triggers (lost/uninstall/wipe), tags, users and the last reported status. Start here to find an agent_id. Related: unifyem_agent_get, unifyem_agent_list_by_tag.

endpoints.name: Get Agent
endpoints.description: Get metadata and last reported status for one agent.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: List Agents By Tag
endpoints.description: List agents that carry a given tag. Use this to fan a command out to a group: call it, then issue the unifyem_cmd_* tool once per agent_id.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag to match exactly.

endpoints.name: Rename Agent
endpoints.description: Set the friendly name shown for an agent.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: friendly_name
parameters.description: New human-readable name for the agent.

endpoints.name: Delete Agent
endpoints.description: Delete an agent record from the server. The agent software is not touched; use unifyem_agent_trigger_uninstall to remove software first.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Trigger Lost Mode
endpoints.description: Mark an agent as lost. On its next sync the agent enters lost mode, which affects the device's user. Clear with unifyem_agent_trigger_reset.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: triggers.lost
parameters.description: Fixed value

endpoints.name: Trigger Uninstall
endpoints.description: Instruct the agent to uninstall itself on its next sync. Clear before it syncs with unifyem_agent_trigger_reset.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: triggers.uninstall
parameters.description: Fixed value

endpoints.name: Trigger Wipe
endpoints.description: Instruct the agent to wipe the endpoint's disk on its next sync. Irreversible once the agent syncs. Clear before it syncs with unifyem_agent_trigger_reset.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: triggers.wipe
parameters.description: Fixed value

endpoints.name: Reset Agent Triggers
endpoints.description: Clear the lost, uninstall and wipe triggers on an agent.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: List Agent Tags
endpoints.description: List the tags attached to an agent.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Add Agent Tags
endpoints.description: Attach one or more tags to an agent. Existing tags are kept.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags to add.

endpoints.name: Remove Agent Tags
endpoints.description: Detach one or more tags from an agent.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags to remove.

endpoints.name: Add Agent Users
endpoints.description: Associate UnifyEM user records with an agent (the people who use the device). Users must already exist; see unifyem_user_list and unifyem_user_add. This does not create OS accounts; use unifyem_cmd_user_add for that.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: users
parameters.description: UnifyEM user IDs to associate.

endpoints.name: Remove Agent Users
endpoints.description: Remove the association between UnifyEM user records and an agent.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: users
parameters.description: UnifyEM user IDs to disassociate.

endpoints.name: List Agent Requests
endpoints.description: List command requests for one agent with status (new, pending, complete, failed, invalid, cancelled), response text and response data. Passwords in parameters are masked.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Cancel Agent Requests
endpoints.description: Cancel every pending request queued for an agent.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Get Agent Recovery Info
endpoints.description: Return the agent's encrypted recovery blob (service account and BitLocker info) or an empty result if none has been reported. The blob is encrypted to the recovery public key and must be decrypted locally with the private key (uem-cli recovery get).

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: List Agent Events
endpoints.description: List events (messages, alerts, status reports) reported by one agent, optionally filtered by type and time range. Dates are YYYYMMDD; times are Unix seconds.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Event type filter.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start date, YYYYMMDD, inclusive.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End date, YYYYMMDD, inclusive.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start time as Unix seconds. Overrides start.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End time as Unix seconds. Overrides end.

endpoints.name: Command: Ping Agent
endpoints.description: Ask an agent to acknowledge a ping. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Command: Request Status
endpoints.description: Ask an agent to send a fresh status report. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Command: Execute
endpoints.description: Run a program or shell command on the endpoint. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: args.cmd
parameters.description: Program or command to run on the endpoint.

parameters.name: args.arg1
parameters.description: Optional argument 1 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg2
parameters.description: Optional argument 2 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg3
parameters.description: Optional argument 3 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg4
parameters.description: Optional argument 4 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg5
parameters.description: Optional argument 5 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg6
parameters.description: Optional argument 6 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg7
parameters.description: Optional argument 7 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg8
parameters.description: Optional argument 8 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg9
parameters.description: Optional argument 9 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg10
parameters.description: Optional argument 10 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg11
parameters.description: Optional argument 11 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg12
parameters.description: Optional argument 12 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.ssh
parameters.description: Set to "true" to run the command via SSH-style shell handling.

endpoints.name: Command: Download And Execute
endpoints.description: Download a file from a URL to the endpoint and execute it. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: args.url
parameters.description: URL to download from.

parameters.name: args.hash
parameters.description: Expected SHA256 hash of the download, base64 encoded. Verified before execution.

parameters.name: args.arg1
parameters.description: Optional argument 1 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg2
parameters.description: Optional argument 2 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg3
parameters.description: Optional argument 3 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg4
parameters.description: Optional argument 4 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg5
parameters.description: Optional argument 5 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg6
parameters.description: Optional argument 6 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg7
parameters.description: Optional argument 7 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg8
parameters.description: Optional argument 8 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg9
parameters.description: Optional argument 9 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg10
parameters.description: Optional argument 10 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg11
parameters.description: Optional argument 11 passed to the command.

parameters.name: args.arg12
parameters.description: Optional argument 12 passed to the command.

endpoints.name: Command: Upgrade Agent
endpoints.description: Instruct the agent to download and install the latest agent build from the server. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Command: Refresh Service Account
endpoints.description: Instruct the agent to generate a new service account password and report it to the server. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Command: Reboot
endpoints.description: Reboot the endpoint. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Command: Shutdown
endpoints.description: Shut the endpoint down. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Command: List OS Users
endpoints.description: List local OS accounts on the endpoint (domain, name, disabled, administrator). The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

endpoints.name: Command: Add OS User
endpoints.description: Create a local OS account on the endpoint. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: args.user
parameters.description: Local OS account name on the endpoint.

parameters.name: args.password
parameters.description: Password for the local OS account.

parameters.name: args.admin
parameters.description: Set to "true" to make the account a local administrator.

endpoints.name: Command: Delete OS User
endpoints.description: Delete a local OS account from the endpoint. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: args.user
parameters.description: Local OS account name on the endpoint.

parameters.name: args.shutdown
parameters.description: Set to "true" to shut the endpoint down after the operation.

endpoints.name: Command: Set OS User Admin
endpoints.description: Grant or revoke local administrator rights for an OS account. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: args.user
parameters.description: Local OS account name on the endpoint.

parameters.name: args.admin
parameters.description: "true" to grant administrator rights, "false" to revoke.

endpoints.name: Command: Set OS User Password
endpoints.description: Change the password of a local OS account. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: args.user
parameters.description: Local OS account name on the endpoint.

parameters.name: args.password
parameters.description: Password for the local OS account.

endpoints.name: Command: Lock OS User
endpoints.description: Lock (disable) a local OS account. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: args.user
parameters.description: Local OS account name on the endpoint.

parameters.name: args.shutdown
parameters.description: Set to "true" to shut the endpoint down after the operation.

endpoints.name: Command: Unlock OS User
endpoints.description: Unlock (enable) a local OS account and set its password. The command is queued and delivered on the agent's next sync. Returns a request_id; poll unifyem_request_get with it to see the result.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Fixed value

parameters.name: args.agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID as returned by unifyem_agent_list (format A-xxxxxxxx-...).

parameters.name: args.user
parameters.description: Local OS account name on the endpoint.

parameters.name: args.password
parameters.description: Password for the local OS account.

endpoints.name: List Requests
endpoints.description: List every command request on the server across all agents, with status and results. Passwords in parameters are masked.

endpoints.name: Get Request
endpoints.description: Get one command request by request_id: status (new, pending, complete, failed, invalid, cancelled), response text and any response data. Use this to wait for a unifyem_cmd_* result.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Request ID returned by a unifyem_cmd_* tool (format R-...).

endpoints.name: Cancel Request
endpoints.description: Cancel a pending request so it is not delivered to the agent.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Request ID to cancel.

endpoints.name: Delete Request
endpoints.description: Delete a request record from the server.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Request ID to delete.

endpoints.name: Get Report
endpoints.description: Generate a server-side report. Currently only the "agents" report exists.

parameters.name: report
parameters.description: Report name.

parameters.name: args.format
parameters.description: Output format.

endpoints.name: List Users
endpoints.description: List UnifyEM user records (people who use managed devices, not server administrators).

endpoints.name: Get User
endpoints.description: Get one UnifyEM user record.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User ID as returned by unifyem_user_list.

endpoints.name: Add User
endpoints.description: Create a UnifyEM user record. Associate it with devices using unifyem_agent_users_add.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Username / user ID.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address.

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: Display name.

endpoints.name: Delete User
endpoints.description: Delete a UnifyEM user record.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User ID to delete.

endpoints.name: Get Agent Config
endpoints.description: Get the global configuration pushed to all agents (sync intervals, logging, CA pinning, verification, recovery info).

endpoints.name: Set Agent Config
endpoints.description: Update one or more global agent configuration values. Keys must already exist: sync_interval, sync_pending, sync_retry, sync_lost, status_interval, log_retention, log_stdout, log_windows_disk, log_windows_events, log_macos_disk, log_linux_disk, log_debug, pin_ca, verification, recovery_info. Read current values with unifyem_config_agents_get first.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Object of key to string value, e.g. {"sync_interval": "300"}.

endpoints.name: Get Server Config
endpoints.description: Get the UnifyEM server configuration (listen address, external URL, paths, timeouts, token lifetimes, retention, authorized admin IPs).

endpoints.name: Set Server Config
endpoints.description: Update one or more server configuration values. Keys must already exist: log_file, log_stdout, log_retention, listen, external_url, data_path, files_path, db_path, http_timeout, http_idle_timeout, max_concurrent, penalty_box_min, penalty_box_max, handler_timeout, access_token_life, refresh_token_life_users, authorized_admin_ips, request_retries, request_retry_delay, agent_retention_days, event_retention_days, request_retention_days, recovery_public_key. Some values only take effect after a server restart. Read current values with unifyem_config_server_get first.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Object of key to string value, e.g. {"event_retention_days": "90"}.

endpoints.name: Get Registration Token
endpoints.description: Get the current agent installation token (base64 of server URL plus registration token) used with "uem-agent install <token>".

endpoints.name: New Registration Token
endpoints.description: Generate a new registration token and return the new installation token. The previous token stops working for new installs; already-registered agents are unaffected.

endpoints.name: Set Recovery Public Key
endpoints.description: Upload the recovery public key (PEM) that agents use to encrypt recovery info. Generate the keypair locally with "uem-cli recovery keygen" and keep the private key offline.

parameters.name: public_key
parameters.description: PEM-encoded public key.

endpoints.name: Create Deploy File
endpoints.description: Regenerate deploy.json with SHA256 hashes of the uem-* files in the server's files directory. Run after copying new agent binaries there so agents can verify upgrades.
